verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's own docs say you can roll back a Worker, which covers the automations deployed on it, to a previously deployed version using Wrangler or the dashboard. That shows first-party versioned deployments and rollback. A first-party review step is not documented; the Git and GitHub Actions mention describes fitting into external tools rather than a review feature of the product. Missing for 10: documented in-product review or approval of version changes, detailed versioning docs (version listing, diffs, gradual deployments), and independent or hands-on corroboration of rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: You can roll back to a previously deployed version of your Worker using Wrangler or the Cloudflare dashboard.
